mentions.name: Plain-English hardware product generator
mentions.description: This project generates manufacturable hardware output — PCB, enclosure, and firmware — from plain-English product descriptions. It slots a library of pre-validated subcircuits (microcontroller, power, USB, IO, Bluetooth/Wi-Fi) together on a grid with deterministic routing, so a design that compiles works, and produces enclosure concept art with an image model that is fed to an OpenSCAD-generating model alongside hard constraints like board size, mounting holes, and connector placement, aiming to automate the full hardware product pipeline.
mentions.problem: Most proof-of-concept hardware products are built from the same common subcircuits, yet producing manufacturable files still requires substantial manual work.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on something that lets you describe a hardware product in plain English and get actual manufacturable files out — PCB, enclosure, firmware, the lot.
